name: SHE Security Guard
source:
An armed security guard who is the pride of SHE.

Their average height is around 178cm. 
They are regular employees who handle all aspects of security for SHE. 
They have been trained like spies from a certain country, and their level of training is on a different level to average security guards.

They relentlessly pursue the enemy in order to complete their mission of taking Masaya into custody.

"Officer!! We are so incredibly moved right now!"

(from the game's website)
